sentences.text: Parahesperornis was a flightless, toothed seabird belonging to the group Hesperornithes.
The genus was established by Martin in 1984 with the type species Parahesperornis alexi.
This name was originally applied to a specimen known as YPM 1478, which served as the holotype for a different species.

Fossils are found only in the upper Niobrara Chalk of Kansas, dating to the Coniacian-Santonian boundary between 85 and 82 million years ago.

In 2017, researchers considered the genus Asiahesperornis as a possible synonym of Parahesperornis.
The diversity of Parahesperornis remains enigmatic because similar fossils found in Mongolia lack sufficient diagnostic features to confirm their classification.
